title: First days: start several useful jobs
applies_when: A new settlement has little infrastructure.
approach: Starter checklist: inspect nearby supplies and danger; allow safe starting supplies early; establish a general stockpile near camp to consolidate loose goods; place temporary sleeping spots if needed; queue food production and shelter work in parallel. Adapt this checklist to existing facilities and actual needs rather than repeating completed setup.

Planning marks, stockpile/growing-zone creation and work designations are immediate player orders. Verify them immediately. Hauling, sowing, mining, deconstruction, paths/floors and construction still require pawn labor or materials; queued orders do not mean the work is finished.

Compare repairing explored ruins, enclosing a hill face, mining a room, and new walls. Designate mining or deconstruction explicitly when needed, observe clearance before placing conflicting construction, and reclaim useful materials where labor and safety justify it. Rough rock terrain is not a supply of stone blocks.

Do not postpone allowing supplies or a basic stockpile until a permanent shelter is complete. Allowed loose supplies can already be used for construction; stockpiling organizes them but is not a prerequisite for use.
Near the landing supplies, choose a compact camp with safe access to buildable ground and food. Repair a suitable ruin or build against a hill if it saves work.
Start shelter and food production in parallel: a builder can enclose the camp while a grower sows. Do not wait for finished bedrooms before starting crops.
Arm capable colonists, allow useful nearby supplies, and protect perishables. Add a place to eat and basic recreation as labor permits.
Once immediate needs have orders, plan the next bottleneck: cooking, winter food, power, research or safer walls. Two days of meals is not a finished food system.
verify: Workers are actually building, planting or supplying; queued projects alone are not progress.
reconsider: Weather, injury or an approaching threat changes the immediate priority.
